text:
devon: Anyone else's ISP acting up? Had to move the router three times and now my Zoom background is a pixelated potato :potato: 

maya: omg same. my camera lag turns me into a slideshow. :sweat_smile:

ajay: Speedtest? sometimes neighborhood congestion at this hour. run `speedtest-cli` and post results.

devon: running now...
```
$ speedtest-cli --simple
Ping: 38.23 ms
Download: 9.12 Mbit/s
Upload: 0.86 Mbit/s
```

sam: yikes. that's rough for live calls. any chance you can tether to your phone for the meeting?

devon: tried tethering, phone hotspot drops after 15 min. router's in the hallway right now like a lonely lighthouse. :lantern:

maya: have you tried changing the Wi‑Fi channel? I used the app on my mesh nodes and moved it off the crowded 6. made a big diff.

ajay: also try disabling 2.4GHz on the old router and only use 5GHz if the distance allows. helps with interference.

devon: good call, I'll try. quick question — is there a short script to log connectivity spikes? want to show ISP support some receipts.

sam: this is what I use: `while sleep 10; do date +%s; ping -c 3 8.8.8.8 | tail -n1; done >> ~/connectivity.log`

devon: perfect, thanks. starting that now.

netbot: [automated] Noted: devon reported degraded home internet. Tagging #helpdesk if escalation needed.

maya: also pro tip — if you have an old phone and unlimited data, set it up as an always-on hotspot with a charger. cheaper than yelling at ISP. :grimacing:

devon: haha, might try that. also btw — here's my new background fail (attached) — looks like abstract modern art.

ajay: post the pic! love the chaos. :joy:

devon: https://img.example.com/zoom-potato-173.jpg (low quality warning)

sam: LOL that's gorgeous. congrats on the avant‑garde branding. :tada:

maya: vote: should we start a gallery channel for best Zoom glitches? :art:

ajay: yes. #glitch-gallery immediately.

devon: fine, but only if someone else shares worse than mine. stakes are high.

netbot: [automated] Reminder: If outage persists, please file a ticket with IT and include `~/connectivity.log` and speedtest output.

maya: @devon if you want, I can swing by this weekend with my spare mesh node, set it up quick.
devon: you're a legend, thanks!!! :heart:

sam: also — for folks working from apartments: check if your building has a maintenance window or shared switch reboots scheduled. happened to me once.
ajay: and call your ISP's tech support *after* you collect logs. they take evidence better than vibes.

devon: will do. thanks everyone. back to the router shuffle. :man_dancing:

maya: good luck. post an update later so we can admire the outcome.

(devon pinned message: "connectivity.log" to thread)
